decisions.mechanismComparison: Mnemosyne governs scoped continuity, context budgets, privacy, retrieval, and memory audit, while Aegis governs authority and personal-data boundaries. The legacy personalization route is deferred and the certified durable-state cluster governs project evidence, not behavior-profile extraction. None expresses this candidate's user-authored-only corpus rule, model-call preflight, approval hash, segment cache, worker and reducer validation, and activate-only-complete-pack state transition.
decisions.rationale: Retain this as an explicit-only operational candidate beneath Mnemosyne and Aegis. It must require an already trusted runtime, keep raw sessions private, display exact cost and coverage inputs before model work, reapprove changed plans, and never activate a partial or invalid profile.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Aegis already owns evidence-ranked findings, mitigation verification, residual risk, and security assurance; Phoenix owns root-cause diagnosis; Forge and the certified review and red-green clusters own regression proof. The missing explicit link is a remediation ledger that maps each original finding to its root cause, all located variants, side-effect review, and a regression that would fail on recurrence.
decisions.rationale: Extend Aegis security assurance with the finding-to-remediation completeness ledger, delegating reproduction and code proof to Phoenix and Forge. Do not treat a clean diff, one patched instance, or one passing happy path as closure.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Daedalus and the original refactoring-quality cluster already own test-first change and maintainability review, while Forge and the certified red-green cluster own implementation closure. They do not explicitly require every changed test to name its observable behavior, justify mocks at true boundaries, preserve incident regressions, use real state objects, or prove that each case detects a distinct defect.
decisions.rationale: Extend Daedalus refactoring-quality with this test-review ledger. Keep scope to changed tests unless an audit is requested, preserve cheap contract tests when uncertainty remains, and do not call review findings a passing suite.

decisions.mechanismComparison: The two legacy records are the same verification-before-completion mechanism preserved in Forge's dependency and claim-to-evidence ledger. Forge blocks unsupported completion, Daedalus requires exact verification evidence, and the certified implementation clusters add behavior-level failure and integration proof. The candidate contributes no distinct owner or terminal artifact.
decisions.rationale: Keep the fresh-command, complete-output, scope-matched claim gate in the existing Forge composition and do not create another verification skill from duplicate packaging.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Aegis governs destructive authority, Daedalus governs refactoring and migration evidence, and Forge governs consequential delivery. None currently exposes a single reusable rewrite transaction with a necessity proof, complete preservation ledger, explicit erasure declaration, confirmation bound to an exact target and omissions, scope-expansion stop, and dependent-file compatibility audit.
decisions.rationale: Create a narrow explicit-only operational skill below Aegis and Daedalus. Remove the arbitrary eighty-percent trigger, prefer recoverable deletion, bind confirmation to the exact declaration, require rollback or backup evidence, and fall back to targeted repair when necessity is not proved.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Logos and its concise-editorial evidence already preserve meaning, voice, audience, canon, uncertainty, and bounded claims. The certified constraint-driven revision cluster already treats style lists as optional controls rather than universal law. This candidate's located-pattern and second-pass technique fits inside that stronger owner.
decisions.rationale: Retain passage location, context-sensitive exceptions, edit reasons, and a second audit as Logos techniques. Do not create a universal anti-pattern censor or let polished style conceal unsupported claims.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Athena appraises inference validity and Atlas owns bounded analysis and reproducibility, while the original and Wave 2 comparison clusters govern experiments and evaluator bias. None supplies a model-family-specific operational path for GLM, discrete, mixed, and time-series inference with residual, influence, convergence, covariance, multiplicity, missingness, encoding, leakage, and interpretation gates.
decisions.rationale: Create a provider-adaptable operational skill under Athena and Atlas. Separate inference from prediction, require design and outcome semantics before model selection, pin implementations only in adapters, report effect uncertainty and diagnostics, and refuse causal language unsupported by identification.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Logos and the original documentation evidence govern meaning, structure, provenance, and bounded local writing, while Aegis governs untrusted package and redaction risk. They do not define DOCX ZIP-entry safety, XML-order validation, run fragmentation, accepted-versus-redline views, tracked paragraph deletion, six-part comment linkage, or rendered-page acceptance.
decisions.rationale: Create an independently written document-package operational skill that delegates prose to Logos and authority to Aegis. Use available local renderers and validators rather than assuming bundled scripts, preserve untouched package parts, strip unsafe archive links, verify tracked authorship, and inspect every rendered page before completion.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Atlas owns generic reconciliation and quality gates, Athena owns scientific validity, and Daedalus routes specialist methods. The certified misroute clusters correctly preserve genomics as a specialist boundary but do not provide the candidate's coordinate-convention conversion, reference-allele check, assembly signature, contig compatibility, indel normalization, transcript-version, and fatal-audit mechanism.
decisions.rationale: Create a narrow operational skill under Atlas and Athena. Every coordinate must carry convention and assembly, variant comparison must normalize against a named reference, incompatible builds and REF mismatches stop the workflow, and transcript or protein conversion must delegate to a versioned transcript model.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Logos already preserves meaning, voice, source facts, and maintenance context in editorial and documentation routes; Daedalus supplies full implementation context and diff verification. The certified documentation cluster adds exact claim and example integrity. Comment classification, warning preservation, and stale-text reporting are bounded techniques inside that composition.
decisions.rationale: Keep the comment audit as a Logos-to-Daedalus technique. Read the enclosing code and dependents, preserve warnings and non-obvious rationale, avoid formatting churn, and report uncertainty rather than deleting comments whose intent cannot be proved stale.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Muse already owns purpose-led semantic motion, frame-rate-independent timing, reduced motion, performance tiers, device budgets, render-pass verification, and rejection criteria. The certified motion and responsive-system clusters add interruptibility, geometry, touch, and measured device performance. The candidate's layout-thrash and layer-promotion checks fit as implementation details under that stronger contract.
decisions.rationale: Retain read-write separation, composited-property preference, bounded animation loops, paint diagnosis, and measured layer budgets inside Muse's motion and visual-acceptance routes. Do not create a second motion owner.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Muse already integrates interface art direction, semantic structure, keyboard and focus proof, responsive behavior, reduced motion, performance, status messaging, issue ledgers, and bounded repair. The certified async-state and art-direction clusters cover recovery states and coherent rendered acceptance. The candidate contributes a mobile heuristic checklist but no stronger owner or proof model.
decisions.rationale: Keep gesture discoverability, safe-area, perceived-performance, reversibility, recovery, and dark-pattern checks as mobile fixtures under Muse. Require named devices and assistive technologies before any platform or accessibility verdict.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Athena governs scientific inference validity, Atlas governs reproducible analysis, and Daedalus routes specialist implementation. The certified science misroutes correctly refuse flattening domain methods into unrelated owners. None defines quantum-specific tensor ordering, physical-state validity, Lindblad rate semantics, approximation disclosure, solver selection, trajectory uncertainty, steady-state residuals, and convergence sweeps.
decisions.rationale: Create a narrow scientific operational skill whose portable core is independent of QuTiP versions and whose adapters pin exact solvers. Require units, subsystem order, physical invariants, approximations, numerical controls, convergence evidence, and a hard separation between simulation and hardware execution.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Forge already terminates with fresh verification, review disposition, explicit integration state, rollback, and finishing-a-development-branch delegation. Herald owns release policy and lifecycle, and the original branch workflow is already represented. The candidate's merge, PR, preserve, and confirmed-discard matrix is therefore existing composition detail.
decisions.rationale: Keep the option matrix and cleanup coupling inside Forge. Recheck repository policy and working-tree ownership, require exact destructive confirmation, rerun tests after local integration, and preserve worktrees while review or follow-up remains.

decisions.mechanismComparison: The certified product-experiment cluster already requires a single-change hypothesis, frozen primary outcome, powered sample, assignment telemetry, harm guardrails, fixed duration, and predeclared decision rules. Prometheus owns the product artifact, Atlas owns reproducibility, and Beacon owns measurement and causal limits. The candidate is a narrower duplicate of that stronger composition.
decisions.rationale: Route product experiment readiness through Prometheus with Atlas and Beacon. Preserve the anti-peeking, invariant-exposure, attribution, and inconclusive-outcome controls without creating a second experiment gate.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Daedalus owns telemetry integration, Phoenix owns observability diagnosis, and Architect owns reliability controls. The original observability cluster is broad, while the certified thin-error cluster lacks provider proof. This candidate adds a specific on-call-question-to-signal matrix, bounded-cardinality rule, propagation check, symptom alert, induced known path, and inspection of actual signal plus delivery.
decisions.rationale: Extend Daedalus's integrations-observability route with this self-verifying signal contract. Keep production mutation, credentials, alert delivery, and deliberate failure injection separately authorized, and require redaction plus cardinality budgets before emitting telemetry.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Muse already owns visual acceptance, device coverage, accessibility, performance budgets, and independent rejection criteria, while Daedalus can implement measurement fixtures. The candidate uniquely adds narrow-width overflow probes, ordered-task centroid transit, collision overlays, target-size measurements, and a repeatable geometry packet instead of relying on attractive screenshots.
decisions.rationale: Extend Muse visual acceptance with optional geometry and task-transit evidence. Thresholds must be derived from the product and platform, screenshots must share deterministic state, and a separate judge may supplement but not replace measurements and accessibility proof.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Hermes already owns element discovery, browser lifecycle, Playwright or agent-browser planning, screenshots, and closeout. The certified rendered-webapp cluster is behaviorally equivalent: inspect static markup or wait for dynamic render, discover selectors before action, exercise the named flow, capture evidence, and close resources. Daedalus supplies project tests and implementation proof.
decisions.rationale: Use the certified browser route under Hermes. Preserve the exact useful rule that unread helpers are never executed as black boxes, and keep server startup, network access, credentials, and external targets explicitly authorized.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Muse already requires rendered state coverage, deterministic baselines, accessibility, performance, issue ledgers, rejection criteria, and independent visual judgment, while Daedalus can implement and retest repairs. The certified reconnaissance cluster supplies browser-visible task evidence. The candidate's heuristic table and before-and-after trace are useful fixtures inside that stronger system.
decisions.rationale: Retain untouched-default capture, located severity, primary-task consequences, separate judging, and repeat scoring under Muse. Do not treat heuristic scores alone as product truth or accessibility conformance.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Athena was already independently implemented from this exact body and now expresses the complete claim, design, measurement, bias, confounding, statistical, causal, heterogeneity, uncertainty, and proportional-conclusion contract. Oracle adds current source provenance, and the comparison evidence covers reproducibility and evaluator bias. No residual mechanism remains.
decisions.rationale: Keep the exact source as Athena provenance and do not synthesize a duplicate. Scientific conclusions remain bounded by methods and evidence, and personalized medical, legal, regulatory, or ethics decisions remain outside the skill.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Logos owns product and internal decision narratives with verified facts and uncertainty, Oracle supplies source labels and confidence, and Prometheus owns the operational decision context. The certified evidence-to-decision cluster already preserves recommendation, sequence, uncertainty, and requested decision. The candidate adds a useful one-page template but no new authority.
decisions.rationale: Retain decision-first ordering, sourced facts, reversible options, evidence gaps, and named owners in the existing Logos composition. Page length and section order remain brief constraints, not universal law.

decisions.mechanismComparison: Logos and Oracle already derive technical documentation from exact implementation evidence, distinguish fact and inference, preserve paths and symbols, and verify material claims. The certified engineering and repository documentation clusters add exhaustive claim inventories, sample execution, stale-name sweeps, setup, architecture, tests, and troubleshooting. VitePress and Mermaid are packaging adapters.
decisions.rationale: Keep file-and-symbol citation, fact-versus-inference labeling, diagram source coverage, and path validation inside Logos. Do not create a wiki-specific skill or infer publication readiness from a rendered local page.
